resumeText: Liam Harris is a RAG / Information Retrieval Engineer at Corvid Search with five years of experience. He designs vector database schemas and indexes millions of documents, manages embedding generation and updates for accuracy and freshness, and owns the retrieval pipeline from hybrid search to reranking. He applies NLP techniques to chunking, query understanding, and evaluation, and prototypes with LangChain and Elasticsearch. Previously at LinguaSoft he built NLP systems. His focus is retrieval quality at scale.
